title: 纸面棱角平衡
description: 剪纸层叠把外棱变成两块清楚墙面，成人稳稳保持低位接触。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: An original layered-paper illustration depicts a fictional adult balancing next to a broad rounded arete formed by two colored indoor wall planes. Large amber handholds and generous positive footholds create a low compact route on both faces, with the adult keeping three steady contacts while shifting one foot. Show the entire opaque-clothed figure from a wide three-quarter angle, including uninterrupted crash mats and empty landing space around the edge. Use visible paper fibers, deep blue and cream wall layers, and subtle stacked shadows. Keep limb proportions adult and contact points credible. No lettering, brands, leaps, extreme wrapping poses, high exposure, or portrait frame.
